snippet.title: Moses & Plato - Official Release Date Trailer | The MIX | Kinda Funny Spring Game Showcase
snippet.description: Watch the latest Moses & Plato: Last Train to Clawville trailer for this upcoming murder mystery where you are the main suspect! An ambassador on a peace mission has been killed on board the Clawville Express. Time progresses as you sniff out clues, eavesdrop on conversations, and interrogate passengers. Can you solve the case before the train reaches the last station? Or else. Moses & Plato: Last Train to Clawville will be available on PC on April 14, 2026.
